purpose: Test repeated GPU kernel launches on the same batched state storage after the large-nstates gate showed a GPU win.
preconditions: artifacts/ and reports/ are ignored generated outputs

batched_gpu_runs: dumped state byte size equals storage_size * nstates when dump is requested
no raw-byte CPU/GPU equality claim is made for repeated batched states

non_claims: no target-breadth claim because this gate uses only tlul_fifo_sync
CPU repeated steps are modeled as repeated eval_step calls after initialization
